ObjectStates.Name: backgammon_piece_white
ObjectStates.Description:
made by stella
place onto a card/deck and click set to apply the current image to that card/deck, flip the card to place onto the other side
ObjectStates.LuaScript:
--[[--
packed from https://github.com/0x57e11a/moontable/src/modules/cardchanger

manifest:
-	src/modules/cardchanger/mod
-	src/lib/tts (omitted - buildtime dependency)
-	src/modules/cardchanger/presets
please don't make changes here, instead fork the github repo and use the provided build scripts,
it *will* make your life easier, and your changes will be able to be contributed to the project
--]]--

-- tcejbo gninwapS -- worm guard (most common worm looks for this and wont attach itself if it's present)

local require

local sources = {
	["src/modules/cardchanger/mod"] = function()
require("src/lib/tts")
local presets = require("src/modules/cardchanger/presets")

local image = ""

function onLoad(saved_state)
   image = saved_state
   self.UI.setAttribute("url", "text", image)
end

function onSave()
   return image
end

function change(_, value)
   image = value
end

function preset(_, selected_index, id)
   local index = tonumber(selected_index)
   if index == 0 then return end
   image = presets[index]
   self.UI.setAttribute("url", "text", image)
   self.UI.setAttribute(id, "value", 0)
end

local function get_object()
   local hit = Physics.cast({
      origin = self.positionToWorld(vector(0, -0.06, 0)),
      direction = vector(0, -1, 0),
      type = 1,
      max_distance = 0.15,
      debug = true,
   })[1]

   log(hit)

   if not hit then return end

   local obj = hit.hit_object
   if obj.spawning then return end

   return obj
end





function get_image()
   local obj = get_object()
   if obj == nil then return end

   if obj.type == "Card" then
      local custom = obj.getCustomObject()

      if math.abs(obj.getRotation().z - 180) > 90 then image = custom.face
      else image = custom.back end
   elseif obj.type == "Deck" then
      local card = obj.takeObject({
         position = self.getPosition(),
         top = true,
         smooth = false,
      })
      local custom = card.getCustomObject()
      if math.abs(card.getRotation().z - 180) > 90 then image = custom.face
      else image = custom.back end
      obj.putObject(card)
   end

   self.UI.setAttribute("url", "text", image)
end

function set_image()
   local obj = get_object()
   if not obj then return end

   if obj.type == "Card" then
      local custom = obj.getCustomObject()

      if math.abs(obj.getRotation().z - 180) > 90 then custom.face = image
      else custom.back = image end

      obj.setCustomObject(custom)
   elseif obj.type == "Deck" then
      local origin = obj.getPosition()
      local front = math.abs(obj.getRotation().z - 180) > 90
      local i = 0
      while obj ~= nil and (obj.type == "Card" or #obj.getObjects() > 0) do
         local card
         if obj.type == "Card" then
            card = obj
            obj = nil
         else
            card = obj.takeObject({
               position = origin,
               top = false,
               smooth = false,
            })
            obj = obj.remainder or obj
         end
         i = i + 1
         card.setPosition(origin + vector(0, i * 0.1, 0))
         self.setPosition(origin + vector(0, i * 0.1 + 0.1, 0))

         local custom = card.getCustomObject()

         if front then custom.face = image
         else custom.back = image end

         card.setCustomObject(custom)
      end
   end
end

function new_card()
   self.setPosition(self.positionToWorld(vector(0, 0.1, 0)))
   local object = spawnObject({
      type = "CardCustom",
      position = self.positionToWorld(vector(0, -0.1, 0)),
      rotation = self.getRotation() + vector(0, 180, 0),
   })
   object.setCustomObject({
      face = "https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/15185541451470705656/F30AF9900896B2A1CCFD0232576EA95D2892F119/",
      back = "https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/12320714483281881208/8BAD1800AEB07E70538AF4F1475955712E3294FD/",
   })
end
	end,
	["src/lib/tts"] = function()
-- omitted - buildtime dependency
	end,
	["src/modules/cardchanger/presets"] = function()
return {
   "https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/16190787540551910228/D05FCA139C0AD593979E96F7BA79F681325A5630/",
}
	end,
}

local cache = {}

require = function(name)
	if cache[name] then return cache[name] end

	local source = assert(sources[name], "attempted to import module that was not packed: " .. name)
	local ret = source()
	cache[name] = ret
	return ret
end

require("src/modules/cardchanger/mod")

	position="85 -25 -15"
	width="40"

	onClick="new_card"
>new</Button>
